upstream.description: Open-source ManyChat alternative: comment-dm automation + account analytics. NOTE: the link below will not allow you to OAuth; you must self-host with your own API keys.

classification.analysis: OpenReply is a self-hosted, open-source alternative to ManyChat for Instagram comment-to-DM automation: when a comment matches a keyword, it sends the commenter a private reply via Meta's official Instagram API, with optional public replies, tracked links, follow gates, and per-account rate limiting. Built on Next.js, Prisma/PostgreSQL, and BullMQ/Redis with a separate worker process for sending, it targets creators and small agencies who want ManyChat-style comment automation without a recurring subscription or seat limits. It uses only the official Meta API (no scraping or password use) and includes multi-account workspaces with roles for agency use.

use_cases.title: Auto-DM a link to anyone who comments a keyword on an Instagram post
Self-host a free ManyChat-style comment-to-DM tool for creator clients
Track click-through rates on links sent via automated Instagram DMs
